prompt: I'm sending you a screenshot of Linear's issue list. Translate the layout into our project. Don't copy verbatim; make it ours. Walk me through your process.
expected_output: Per references/iteration-patterns.md § Reference-image translation protocol: agent (a) names the layout pattern out loud first ('three-column nav-list-detail layout, with command-palette-driven navigation in the chrome'). (b) Extracts the palette from the screenshot and identifies it as approximately Pure Slate dark + Indigo accent (Linear's actual palette per references/colour-palettes.md § Dark-mode-first variations). Maps the source values onto the project's existing tokens; doesn't lift the literal hex values. (c) Identifies the type pairing as Inter sans-serif throughout (Linear's chosen pairing); finds the project's equivalent in font-pairings.md or maps to whatever the project committed in tokens.md. (d) Names the design movement: Swiss / International + Dark-mode-first per style-catalogue.md. (e) Calls out what to deliberately change vs preserve: preserves the three-column structure, the command-palette pattern, the keyboard-first navigation; changes the colour palette to the project's brand (or notes that Linear's palette suits the project), substitutes the project's font pairing if different. (f) Recreates in .pen using project tokens (references $tokens, never literal hex or font names from the source). Documents the translation choices in the design's context.
